## Pieces + Reed-Solomon recovery (encrypted, signed solid archive of `corpus`)

- 15 pieces x 64 KiB, 3 parity pieces (20 %), Merkle root `691931ecda0a17be…`
- after corrupting 3 pieces: verify reports bad pieces [1, 3, 5] (recoverable: True); recover repaired 3; verify afterwards ok = True, entries ok = 10/10

## Offline volume set (default archive of `corpus`, 4 data + 2 parity volumes, adaptive piece size)

- archive 956,729 bytes -> 6 volumes totalling 1,514,384 bytes (158 % of the archive: parity 2/4 = 50 % plus piece padding and descriptors) with the adaptive piece size of 64 KiB, split in 0.03 s
- two of six drives removed: inspect --verify reports missing volumes [2, 5], reconstructible = True
- join from the remaining four in 0.02 s, 4 pieces rebuilt from parity, archive hash verified = True, bit-identical to the original = True
